description: List, read, create, update or delete Social AI website projects, and assign package slots. Always show previewUrl/manageUrl as clickable markdown links, e.g. [Preview](url) and [Manage](url). To create FROM A TEMPLATE use create_website_from_template instead (better results than a blank site). Deleting is permanent — confirm with the user first.

active.description: set_package_slot: true assigns this website to a package slot; false makes it an inactive draft (default true)

limit.description: list: max projects to return (default 100, max 200). If the user asks for ALL websites, pass 200.

projectId.description: Website project ID — required for every action except list/create

replace.description: set_package_slot: deactivate other active package websites if needed so this one can become active (default true)

name: manage_websites
